title: SITC of pedestal based token/coin operated all weather binoculars
summary: GeM two-packet bid for supply, installation, testing and commissioning of seven pedestal-based token/coin-operated all-weather tourist binoculars at lighthouses under the Goa Directorate (Karnataka, Goa and Maharashtra coast).

scope.item: Pedestal-based, token/coin operated all weather binoculars, supply, installation, testing and commissioning

money.notes: EMD advisory bank SBI; beneficiary Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa. MII and MSE purchase preference enabled (MSE L1+15% up to 25%). ICT: 90% of product cost on delivery, minimum 10% for installation/commissioning/testing within 18 days of site readiness. Estimated bid value not printed.

eligibility: Bidder minimum average annual turnover Rs 28 lakh (3 years)
3 years past experience; past performance 30% of bid quantity
MSE and startup exemption for experience and turnover
Documents: experience, past performance, turnover, certificates requested in ATC, OEM authorization, BoQ specification compliance
Imported products: OEM or authorized seller must have registered office in India for after-sales service
Functional service centre in consignee state (carry-in warranty), dedicated/toll-free service number and escalation matrix
specs: Detailed buyer specification document referenced ('Download') but not included
